# Native Home dashboard

The serialized runner launched the task-owned macOS Desktop against the same absolute home and Sessions, without copying Session data. Product build `dca95340aa978aedfb82b09feef878bf7ab401b9`; Desktop image 2522×1640, dark, Chinese.

The actual dashboard journey passed: four owner-backed cards, precise24h/7d/30d ranges, explicit refresh with no generated Tob report, and recent Channel navigation alongside mounted Home. Browser page errors were empty. The candidate stopped and the runner restored the prior Desktop.

The published after image matches the old Home image's platform, pixel dimensions, theme and locale. Synthetic QA identities differ, so it compares the available surfaces rather than identical account data. Reported usage includes real provider costs even for a later Human-cancelled Tool wait; a cancelled Turn is not free or zeroed.

First launch failed before the candidate started because an unrelated process held the requested inspection port. The runner left it untouched and moved only the private helper's inspection/CDP ports. That pre-launch failure is preserved separately.

Native embedded creation, simple Home-to-DM model Turn and same-Profile restart are queued separately. They are not qualified by this dashboard result. Pending attention source navigation and missing-model runtime remain explicit unfinished checks; the question-bridge failure is recorded in the Web evidence file.
